channel.title: Agri & fertilisers · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Agri & fertilisers in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+1.7).

item.title: [+1] Brent crashes about 8.7% to near $94.6, a two-month low, as the White House ties midterm losses to the war
item.description:
Fourth straight fall from $117.64 on 30 October; slipped toward $93 on Thursday after the US ruled out immediate strikes. Hormuz crossings reportedly near pre-war levels. Sharp reversal.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Fertiliser costs ease

Why it matters: A $23 drop in a week sharply cuts India's import bill, fuel-subsidy burden and inflation risk, easing pressure on the rupee and bonds.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +2, Inflation outlook +2

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Iran's government confirms Indian ships are exempt from Hormuz restrictions, citing medicine imports
item.description:
China, Iraq and Qatar are also exempt; India pays no transit fee. Confirms yesterday's lawmaker report; Iran links it to India's political support. Upgraded from unverified.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Fertiliser feedstock

Why it matters: Free passage for Indian-flagged and India-bound ships cuts supply and freight risk for oil and LNG importers, a direct relief for refiners and gas users.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +1, Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
